decisions.reason: The caption-style naming effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting style_name to "caption text"; no additional or corrected Event is needed.

Naming the caption style does not alter pasted-table structure or column containment behavior.
The source decision does not affect Tab-driven list hierarchy or nested-list alignment.
